## GPS Setter v0.2.0

A big one — brand-new glassmorphism dark UI and A→B route playback over real roads.

### ✨ New
- **New look**: dark glassmorphism UI across the app, with a dark map style.
- **Accent colour picker** in Settings (Blue / Green / Violet / Amber / Pink), applied app-wide.
- **Route mode**: tap **A** and **B** on the map to travel a real road route between them.
  - Road routing via **OpenRouteService** with an automatic **OSRM** fallback (no key needed for the fallback).
  - **Directions sheet**: named start/end, swap A↔B, re-pick a point, adjustable speed (±), live distance & ETA.
  - **Travelling sheet**: live distance travelled, current speed and time-to-arrival, with a smooth **speed ramp from 0** at the start.
- **GPX route playback** with altitude / speed / bearing motion, so spoofed fixes move realistically.
- **Favorites import/export** (JSON via the system file picker).
- **Quick Settings tiles** for favorite locations, plus a Stop action on the notification.

### 🛠 Improvements
- Lat/lng now stored with full double precision (~1 m instead of ~coarse float).
- Update check only offers strictly newer releases.
- Dependencies moved from alpha to stable; Dependabot re-enabled.
- Toolchain: **AGP 8.13.2 / Gradle 8.14.3, libxposed 102, compileSdk 37**.

### 🐞 Fixes
- Favorite toasts, search delay, joystick, and notification bugs.
- Dead code removed; CI now builds and runs unit tests on every push/PR.

### 📦 Downloads
- `app-foss-arm64-v8a-release.apk` — MapLibre + microG (OpenFreeMap tiles, ORS routing). No Google dependencies.
- `app-full-arm64-v8a-release.apk` — Google Maps + Play Services.

Requires LSPosed (or a compatible Xposed framework). Enable the module and reboot.

First release of this fork.

- Migrated to the modern libxposed API (no more deprecated-feature warning)
- System-wide spoofing on Android 12+ with continuous fix generation
- Fixed system hooks on Android 11–13
- FOSS build maps fixed (OpenFreeMap)
- Numerous bug fixes (favorites, search, joystick, notifications, precision)

# GPS Setter

An Xposed module that sets your device's location, built on the modern
[libxposed](https://github.com/libxposed/api) API for LSPosed 2.x / Vector.

Fork of [jqssun/android-gps-setter](https://github.com/jqssun/android-gps-setter),
which builds on [Android1500/GpsSetter](https://github.com/Android1500/GpsSetter).

## Features

- System-wide spoofing on Android 12+: every location fix (GPS, network, fused)
  is replaced inside the system server, so apps don't need to be scoped one by one.
- Continuous 1 Hz fix generation, so Google Play services apps follow the set
  location with Google Location Accuracy left on — even indoors with no GPS signal.
- Real location during emergencies: while an emergency call/SMS is active
  (Android 14+), real fixes pass through untouched.
- Start, stop and location changes apply immediately, without a reboot.
- On-screen joystick to nudge the location live.
- Random-position jitter around the set point.

## Requirements

- Rooted device with **LSPosed 2.x or Vector** (libxposed API 101+).
  LSPosed 1.x cannot load this module.
- Android 8.1+. System-wide spoofing of live updates needs Android 12+.

## Setup

1. Enable **GPS Setter** in LSPosed and tick **System Framework** in its scope
   (optionally also tick individual apps).
2. Reboot.
3. Open the app, pick a location on the map and press play.

## Notes

- Apps protected by Google Play's anti-tamper (those bundling `libpairipcore.so`)
  crash if scoped — don't scope them; rely on the system hook.
- Only enable one location-spoofing module at a time.

Source code & issues: https://github.com/varma322/android-gps-setter

# GPS 设置器

一个 Xposed 模块，用于设置设备的位置，基于现代
[libxpose](https://github.com/libxposed/api) LSPosed 2.x / Vector 的 API。

[jqssun/android-gps-setter](https://github.com/jqssun/android-gps-setter)的分支，
它建立在 [Android1500/GpsSetter](https://github.com/Android1500/GpsSetter) 之上。

## 特点

- Android 12+ 上的系统范围欺骗：每个位置修复（GPS、网络、融合）
  在系统服务器内部替换，因此应用程序不需要一一确定范围。
- 连续 1 Hz 修复生成，因此 Google Play 服务应用程序遵循该设置
  即使在没有 GPS 信号的室内，也可以在 Google 定位精度保持开启的情况下进行定位。
- 紧急情况下的真实位置：紧急呼叫/短信激活时
  （Android 14+），真正的修复未受影响。
- 启动、停止和位置更改立即应用，无需重新启动。
- 屏幕上的操纵杆可实时移动位置。
- 围绕设定点的随机位置抖动。

## 要求

- 使用 **LSPosed 2.x 或 Vector** (libxposed API 101+) 获取 root 权限的设备。
  LSPoded 1.x 无法加载此模块。
- 安卓8.1+。系统范围内的实时更新欺骗需要 Android 12+。

## 设置

1. 在LSPod中启用**GPS Setter**并在其范围内勾选**系统框架**
   （也可以选择勾选单个应用程序）。
2. 重新启动。
3. 打开应用程序，在地图上选择一个位置，然后按播放。

## 注释

- 受 Google Play 防篡改保护的应用程序（捆绑“libpairipcore.so”的应用程序）
  如果范围限定则崩溃——不限定范围；依赖系统钩子。
- 一次仅启用一个位置欺骗模块。

源代码和问题：https://github.com/varma322/android-gps-setter
